# WhatStack: Professional Tech Stack Scan

WhatStack is a professional Chrome extension for performing deep technology scans on websites.

## Features
- Detects 100+ technologies (React, Vue, WordPress, Shopify, etc.)
- Deep "Stack Scan" analysis: Frameworks, Analytics, CMS, Hosting.
- Local execution for maximum privacy.
- Lightweight and developer-focused.

## Links
- Homepage: https://whatstack.vercel.app
- Privacy Policy: https://whatstack.vercel.app/privacy
- GitHub: https://github.com/drdhavaltrivedi/whatstack

## Technical
- Built with Manifest V3.
- Vanilla JavaScript core engine.
- Zero external tracking or data collection.
